name: meridian-analytics
description: Tiny first-party analytics SDK for Figma plugins, Chrome extensions, Snap lenses (Camera Kit / Spectacles) and web apps. Sends anonymous event counts to your Meridian CRM.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=MeridianAnalytics --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/meridian-analytics.global.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
